svg.title: A Python app invoking a Node.js app on one machine, with the calls and addresses shown
svg.desc: A dashed region captioned Local machine holds everything. Inside it, four shapes in a row: a green hexagon named pythonapp, a hexagon carrying the Dapr logo, a second such hexagon, and a blue hexagon named nodeapp. The request runs left to right along the top, numbered one, three and four; the response runs back along the bottom, numbered five, six and seven. A line numbered two drops from the python app's sidecar to a box named mDNS name resolution component standing above the row. Below the row are two cards. The left one is the call the python app makes: POST to http://localhost:3500/v1.0/invoke/nodeapp/method/neworder carrying the body {"orderid":"123","data":"item1"}. The right one is what reaches the Node.js app: POST to http://10.0.0.2:8000/neworder, the address mDNS resolved, carrying the same body.
